reason: Anther cap is the anther cap class.
Crozier is already a synonym of vascular leaf in PO. It is a young coiled frond.
Plural of crozier. Same as R3352.
A spadicle is a small spadix or a spadix branch. Spadix inflorescence is the nearest class.
Plural of spadicle. Same as R3354.
A rachis article is a segment of the inflorescence rachis, mostly in grasses. That is an inflorescence axis internode.
French form of rachis article. Same as R3356.
The word 'disk' carries the shape of the stigma, for example the Papaver stigmatic disc. Mapping to stigma loses it. Not mapped to stigma alone.
A filament tube is the tube formed by fused filaments, which is the staminal tube.
Hyphenated spelling of filament tube.
A filament column is the fused filaments, which is the staminal tube.
A subraceme is a small raceme.
A partial raceme is a raceme unit inside a compound inflorescence.
The beak is the persistent style, mostly in fruits.
Same as R3364.
French form of style beak. Same as R3364.
A partial peduncle is the stalk of a partial inflorescence. That is a higher-order inflorescence axis.
Plural of partial peduncle.
French form of partial peduncle.
A floret is a small flower, and functionally staminate means it works as a male flower.
Functionally male means staminate in function.
Same as R3370.
Tubular florets are the disc florets of Asteraceae. The word 'floret' fixes the family.
Plural of tubular floret.
'Tubular flowers' mostly describes the corolla shape of any family, not Asteraceae disc flowers. Reject, or limit to Asteraceae heads.
'Fleurs tubuleuses' is a shape description used in many families. It is not only disc flowers.
A hypochile lobe is a lobe of the labellum base. The class is the general labellum lobe.
Plural of hypochile lobe.
'Stem-leave' is a typo for stem leaves, which are cauline leaves.
A nectary pit is a nectar-secreting depression, so nectary is the closest class.
Same as R3380.
Involucral leaves are involucral bracts. 'Primary' only marks the order.
A bract of a spike is an inflorescence bract.
Plural of spike bract.
French for bract of the spike.
A filament sheath is the fused filament part, which is the staminal tube. It may be open, which is a quality.
Same as R3386.
'Asexual reproductive body' is generic. It covers gemmae, bulbils, brood bodies and propagules. Gemma is only one kind.
Ostiole is the fig opening only in Ficus. Other plants and fungi have ostioles too, for example perithecia and algal conceptacles.
Fig ostiole is the syconium ostiole.
Exact match.
The inner peristome of a moss capsule is the endostome.
Variant of endostome.
Exact match.
'Secondary rachis' also names an inflorescence axis in palms and grasses. It is the pinna rachis only on a compound leaf or frond.
Rachis of pinna is the pinna rachis.
Rachis of the pinnae is the pinna rachis.
Same as R3395.
Variant spelling of pinna rachis.
French form of secondary rachis. Same as R3395.
